curve.extraction: Union of analytic projected triangle/scanline intervals at 1/8 cell, followed by oriented closed boundaries; extraction lattice is not the final mask
curve.representation: Closed piecewise-linear mathematical curve with RDP point-to-segment bound 0.1875 logical cell; outer rings and holes retain orientation
curve.quantization: Analytic signed curve/cell intersection area A; jointly choose labels q by binary s-t minimum cut
curve.selectionMeaning: Area fidelity balances shared boundary length. Narrow positive or negative regions may disappear or merge as part of region selection. No per-strand connectivity/endcap/all-gap constraints.
curve.designStatus: First bounded prototype. Boundary length discourages unnecessary perimeter, but this is not a proven full pixel-art stair-rhythm/animation metric. 0.14 is an explicit trial parameter, not a user-approved style.
curve.finalBoundary: Oriented closed cell-edge loops of the jointly selected regions. This selected region is the coverage authority, not the original mesh alpha.

ownership.packet: cell, original submesh/primitive, barycentric, original world/UV, depth, normal/tangent; closest projected donor within1.1 cell; depth resolves equal projection distance
ownership.expandedCells: Donor transfer is explicit when selected cell centre lies outside original coverage. Not claimed to be the same camera ray or a newly authored 3D surface.
ownership.drawing: All original hair geometry is replaced by owned cell quads in Raw, Native, World, Independent and Legacy source paths; source sample supplies shading, quad supplies coverage
ownership.occlusion: GPU depth of source donor against original face/body. Original eye S4 hair coverage is disabled; eye visibility consumes the canonical owned all-hair layer.
ownership.parent: Quantized hair union protected original face/feature centre union; no box/hull, eye resizing, or native107-hole repair
ownership.gates: Source fragments use common parent/hair region; Prepare and post-eye/final ownership reject head-family output outside same region. Body/world owners exempt. Existing inside one-cell outline remains derived from coverage.
